Anya: quick note from bring-up this morning: speculative_decode enabled on redwood-30b-4bit in canary. we gained ~18% p95 but saw intermittent "looping" on creative prompts (short repeated phrases).

Leo: looping how? unigram repeats or phrase-level? any regen metric?

Anya: initial regen_rate metric shows jump from 0.03 -> 0.11 on creative_set_500. manual inspection shows both unigram repeats and 3-4 token phrase reiteration.

Priya: what decode config did you flip? fallback policy? prefix overlap?

Anya: default speculative config + prefix_overlap=128 + early_abort=0.2. sampling kept at temp=0.7 top_p=0.92. No change to quant backend aside from int4 weight remap.

Leo: can you paste the exact eval call?

Anya: paste below
```bash
rwictl eval run
  --model redwood-30b-4bit
  --decoding speculative_v2
  --sampling '{"temp":0.7,"top_p":0.92}'
  --prefix-overlap 128
  --evalset creative_holdout_500
  --metrics regen_rate,entropy,var_logits
```

Priya: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T09:04:12Z] regen_rate: baseline 0.03 -> canary 0.11
[2026-03-19T09:04:15Z] avg_entropy: baseline 4.8 -> canary 4.1
[2026-03-19T09:04:20Z] p95_latency: baseline 820ms -> canary 670ms
```

Anya: entropy drop looks suspicious. could be quant-induced low-entropy peaks causing sampler to latch.

Leo: agree. hypothesis: speculative prefetch introduces slightly stale KV states while int4 quant changes logits shape -> lowers entropy bursts -> sampler more likely to repeat.

Priya: next steps: 1) rerun with prefix_overlap=32 and early_abort=0.1, 2) rerun with deterministic topk=1 baseline to measure deterministic repeat ceiling, 3) collect token-level entropy time-series and ngram-regression breakdown.

Anya: kicking jobs now (A: overlap=32+early_abort 0.1, B: deterministic greedy baseline).

OpsBot: Job 54213 created. Allocated to canary-pool-2. ETA ~20m.

Leo: also capture per-step kv-hit-rate and a short diff of logits between float32 and quantized weights for a sample of prompts (first 200 steps).

Priya: + run a tiny ablation where speculative prefetch is enabled but prefix_caching=false so we can separate prefetch from cache reuse.

Anya: noted. will upload raw dumps to /evals/onboard/1748765432 and post results here. if overlap 32 fixes regen and keeps latency, we'll tune default. if not, plan to disable speculative_v2 for 30b-4bit until we fix entropy/clamp behavior.

Leo: thanks. if we see unigram-only loops we might add a micro-nonlinear correction (logit floor) in sampler as quick mitigation.

Priya: ping when jobs finish. :hourglass:
